title: Build a business operating reserve
summary: Separate from your personal EF. Covers business expenses for 2–3 months if income halts.
detailsHtml: The business EF lets you keep the business running — paying subcontractors, software, professional dues, insurance — while your personal EF covers personal life. Mixing them creates the same problem as mixing checking accounts: you can't tell what you actually have for which purpose. Two accounts, two targets.
